changes.motivation: Enforce Effect-idiomatic code by preventing null/undefined returns, directing developers toward Option.none() for absent values and Effect.fail() for error/non-existence signaling.
changes.summary: Added two `no-restricted-syntax` ESLint rules to `eslint.config.ts` banning `return null` and `return undefined` statements. Messages reference `Effect.fail()` for absence-as-failure and `Option.none()` when no result is the expected case. Bare `return;` statements are unaffected.

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule — `findConflictingGroup` returned `null` as a sentinel for no conflict found.
changes.summary: Refactored `findConflictingGroup` in `parser.ts` to return `Option<readonly string[]>` using `Option.some`/`Option.none()`. Updated the call site to use `Option.isSome` and unwrap with `.value`.

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule — an explicit `return undefined` was used for a conditional branch.
changes.summary: Refactored `parentSpanId` logic in `trace-tracer.ts` to use an inverted condition with an implicit return instead of an explicit `return undefined`.

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule — trailing `return undefined` at the end of `parseSessionList`.
changes.summary: Removed the trailing `return undefined` from `find-session-by-project-id.ts` (`parseSessionList` function).

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule — `findWindow` returned `null` when no matching window was found.
changes.summary: Refactored `find-window.ts` to return `Option<TmuxWindow>` via `Option.fromNullable(windows.find(...))` instead of the nullable result.

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule — `getStats` returned `null` when no builder matched.
changes.summary: Refactored `get-stats.ts` to return `Option<BuilderStats>` instead of `BuilderStats | null`, using `Option.fromNullable`.

changes.motivation: Update callers of `getStats` and `findWindow` after their return types changed to `Option`.
changes.summary: Updated `fetch-all-stats.ts` and `poll-status/handler.ts` to unwrap `Option` values from `getStats` using `Option.isSome`/`.value`. Updated callers of `findWindow` similarly.

changes.motivation: Comply with the new ESLint rule across 17 test files where `extractFailureTag`/`extractFailure` helpers and mock Proxy handlers used explicit `return undefined`.
changes.summary: Refactored all test helper functions to use inverted conditions with implicit returns. Updated `findWindow` mocks to return `Option.none()`. Updated assertions in `get-stats.test.ts`, `find-window.test.ts`, and `tmux.test.ts` to match new `Option` return types.

problems: The ESLint rule message went through 4 back-and-forth edits (ban both → remove Option.none → add back Option.none → refine wording) due to unclear initial requirements. The original request 'disallow null or undefined return values' was ambiguous about whether Option was an acceptable alternative, leading to repeated clarification loops.

There was no central documentation of which service methods return Option vs nullable, so determining whether callers expected null-checks or Option-checks required reading multiple files to trace call sites.
